title: PanKbase APIs
bodyHtml:
PanKbase APIs

 

PanKbase Data Library APIs

Capabilities of the Data Library APIs include:

  • Retrieve item details for a unique resource identifier, accession ID, or UUID
  • Search for items within the PanKbase Data Portal
  • Retrieve JSON schema for all item types defined in PanKbase
  • Retrieve JSON schema for all items of a specific type defined in PanKbase
  • Generate a TSV file report based on search query
  • Download files associated with metadata
  • Generate a list of files to download based on a search query
  • Generate a list of items in various collections
Open documentation >>

 

PanKgraph API

Capabilities of the PanKgraph API include:

  • Submit PanKgraph queries using openCypher query language and download results as a JSON string
  • Retrieve detailed gene information for a queried Ensembl gene ID
  • Retrieve counts of genes on a given chromosome
  • Retrieve fine-mapped expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) for a gene in a given tissue using Uberon ontology IDs
  • Retrieve expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) for a gene in a given pathway using Gene Ontology IDs
  • Retrieve a list of effector genes for a phenotype
  • Obtain knowledge graph metadata for nodes (entities) types, edges (relationships) types, and properties (attributes) in PanKgraph
